title: Mass bound for an integer combination: (†) a.e. implies μ_R ≤ |p₁|μ_{R₁} + |p₂|μ_{R₂}
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, let R₁ = (M₁, θ₁, ξ₁), R₂ = (M₂, θ₂, ξ₂), R = (M, θ, ξ) be integer multiplicity triples (IMRep) in U and p₁, p₂ ∈ ℤ. Suppose that for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ ℝ^P (Hⁿ = μHE[n]) the n-vectors satisfy 1_M(x)θ(x)ξ(x) = p₁1_{M₁}(x)θ₁(x)ξ₁(x) + p₂1_{M₂}(x)θ₂(x)ξ₂(x). Then μ_R ≤ |p₁|μ_{R₁} + |p₂|μ_{R₂} as measures on ℝ^P, where μ_{R′} = θ′Hⁿ⌞M′ (IMRep.measure) and |pᵢ| = pᵢ.natAbs acts as a scalar in [0, ∞].
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R₁ R₂ R : IMRep U n) (p₁ p₂ : ℤ), (∀ᵐ x ∂μHE[n], R.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R.mult y : ℝ) • R.orient y) x = (p₁ : ℝ) • R₁.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R₁.mult y : ℝ) • R₁.orient y) x + (p₂ : ℝ) • R₂.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R₂.mult y : ℝ) • R₂.orient y) x) → R.measure ≤ (p₁.natAbs : ℝ≥0∞) • R₁.measure + (p₂.natAbs : ℝ≥0∞) • R₂.measure
